implemented: One local knowledge/document engine with six profiles: project_fact, meeting_brief, research_path, learning_guide, paper_output and lifecycle_review.
Project facts use a separate append-only JSONL source and never overload Document Registry.
Unconfirmed facts remain previews; corrections append with supersedes; unresolved same-kind conflicts require review.
Meeting brief explicitly separates accepted, explore and failed material without format or rendering gates.
Research path preserves confirmed conclusions, uncertainty, negative routes, stop reasons and open hypotheses.
Learning guide remains interface_reserved and expresses commit/file/symbol and experiment references without touching existing guides.
Paper output stops at template_pending, accepts only local project material prefixes and creates no draft without a later template design approval.
Freshness changes produce review_due preview only and do not alter lifecycle, delete documents or close directives.
Knowledge CLI exposes preview/confirm/list/profile/freshness local-only entrypoints.
